description:
Welcome to this after work yoga routine to help you relax and unwind after a busy day. This full body routine will help you stretch your whole body and release any tension that's built up through the day so that you can enjoy your evening.

In this practice we will:
- start in Childs pose giving you time to check in with your body
- move through gentle side stretches, a wrist and spine warm up in tabletop
- open the chest and shoulder in puppy pose, sphinx and release lower back tension with a supine lower back release
- then we'll move into lower body stretches - 3 leg down dog, lizard lunge with a twist, pigeon pose
- finish the way we started by slowing down in Childs pose to help you let go of the work day

I hope you enjoy this after work yoga flow.
